items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: We had a jam session, just the two of us sitting there, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bill used to sit in too. He's in that one. Bill Cray, yeah. He did sit in already, yeah. Raymond played a few jobs, you see.

Well, that was before, Raymond played, I think while Joe was still here. Raymond, Raymond Burke played with the group. He hadn't played since I've been in the group, but I would like very much, you know, the opportunity to play with him, you know. I stopped over at Raymond's shop pretty regular and looked at some of these weird instruments he has in there. And I seen one evening I was passing, coming home from work, and he called me over and showed me this trumpet he had. With a lot of copper tubing on it and…
That's got a tenor mouthpiece and a, for a bell it's got a plunger.
